item.summary: In its interim report for 1 January to 30 September 2026, published on 19 November 2026, H100 Group says fully diluted bitcoin per share rose from 288.49 to 301.06 sats, an increase of 4.36%. The company's bitcoin holdings went from 1,051.03 BTC at the start of the quarter to 3,476.80 BTC at the end, after the acquisition of NSD, which took the holding to 3,506.4 BTC at completion, and a loss of about 30 BTC in an active pool of 233.42 BTC. Profit before tax was 142.9 million kronor, including a one-off gain of 171.0 million kronor from the acquisition; without that gain the result would have been negative. The report has not been reviewed by the company's auditors. The board has called an extraordinary general meeting for 7 December 2026 to seek authorisation to buy back shares; the company has not decided on a buyback, and that meeting has not yet been held.
